svg.aria-label: How I work, as four film frames. 01: “Be curious, not judgmental.” (Ted Lasso · 2020) Start with the person doing the job. Before designing anything, find out how the dispatcher, the operator or the clinician works today, and where it hurts. 02: “Forty-two.” (The Hitchhiker’S Guide To The Galaxy · 1979) Know the question before the answer. A precise answer to a misunderstood question is worth nothing. Pin down the problem and the cost of getting it wrong. 03: “We gotta find a way to make this fit into the hole for this, using nothing but that.” (Apollo 13 · 1995) Make what’s there work together. Every business already runs on systems that were never meant to talk. Connecting them usually beats replacing them. 04: “You solve one problem, and you solve the next one, and then the next.” (The Martian · 2015) Ship the smallest thing that pays. Then the next one. Real usage decides what to build after that, not guesses made up front.
svg.text: TED LASSO · 2020

text.style: font-family:Georgia, 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', 'Times New Roman', serif

Start with the person doing the job.
Before designing anything, find out how the dispatcher, the
operator or the clinician works today, and where it hurts.

svg.text: “Forty-two.”

Know the question before the answer.
A precise answer to a misunderstood question is worth

wrong.

THE MARTIAN · 2015
